items.title: 只读取数与快照装配
items.description: 经用户配置的数据库 MCP 工具按 R1-R7 口径只读提取（需求=未领数量、供给=库存+采购在途+生产在途、竞争需求全量入池），装配可回溯快照 JSON，绝不写库。

items.title: fail-closed 分析引擎
items.description: 本地 Python 引擎（纯标准库）做契约校验与净池分配：缺失≠零需求、不隐式单位换算、不推断历史库存；数据不足即阻断、全部结论判 unknown。

items.title: 分级结论与离线看板
items.description: 工单级五态结论（按期齐套/晚到可补/短缺/无需求/未知），缺口到物料粒度并给出齐套时点；单文件离线看板（CSP 禁外联）可直接分发。

items.title: 缺口治理清单
items.description: live 阻断时输出数据缺口清单（coverage 未确认项、用料清单缺失工单）与治理建议，把 fail-closed 变成数据治理的抓手。

items.title: Read-only extraction & snapshot
items.description: Extracts read-only via the user's database MCP tool under the R1-R7 rules (demand = unissued qty; supply = stock + purchase in-transit + production in-transit; competing demands pooled), assembling a traceable snapshot JSON. Never writes to the database.

items.title: Fail-closed analysis engine
items.description: A local Python engine (stdlib only) validates the contract and allocates the shared net pool: missing ≠ zero demand, no implicit unit conversion, no inferred stock history; insufficient data blocks with all verdicts unknown.

items.title: Graded verdicts & offline dashboard
items.description: Per-order five-state verdicts (on-time / late / shortage / no-demand / unknown) with material-level gaps and ready-at times; a single-file offline dashboard (CSP-restricted) ready to share.

items.title: Gap governance list
items.description: On a live block, emits a data-gap list (unconfirmed coverage keys, orders missing BOMs) with governance advice — turning fail-closed into a data-governance lever.
